In Public Sector & Government, data, analytics & lakehouse is the substrate tower: pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture on databricks and snowflake, streaming and event-driven decisioning, executive bi, master data and cataloging, predictive analytics, and data products that generate revenue. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: data engineering & pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture & migration, real-time streaming & event-driven decisioning — delivered on Achala Forge and Achala Nexus with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Benefits, tax, health and licensing systems never joined; citizens re-submit the same facts to every agency. Fraud and error hide in the seams.
Permits, claims and case files are paper-shaped; processing times measured in months erode trust and increase cost per case.
Aging systems with hardening debt meet rising state-grade threats; accreditation cycles slow every change.
